test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Currently, how many languages are listed in the eighth schedule of the Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is **__22__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Eighth Schedule to the Constitution of India consists of the following** 22 languages**:

 
 
• Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Kashmiri, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Nepali, Oriya, Punjabi, Sanskrit, Sindhi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu, Bodo, Santhali, Maithili and Dogri.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Scheduled languages** are the languages other than the official languages of a country that have been assigned a place in the constitution of the country.
 
• There are** 12 schedules** in our constitution.
